data.description:
## Summary

**RESOLVED**: Historical items that were stuck at pre-audit states after audit-completion have been resolved. Both items received their verdict-driven lifecycle transitions via separate implementation commits.

## Resolution Details

### Items with "Ready to close: Yes" audits (AC1):

| Work Item | Current State | Status |
|-----------|--------------|--------|
| WL-0MSGRJWRX0068W3W (wl next: exclude stage=done) | completed/done | Fixed by commit 6c973e65 (2026-08-06) |
| WL-0MSGJDSMJ004128E (Herdr shortcut hint bar) | deleted/idea | Fixed by commit 2004f41c (2026-08-08), later deleted |

### Items with "Ready to close: No" verdicts (AC2):

| Work Item | Current State | Status |
|-----------|--------------|--------|
| WL-0MSDT8X1V003206G (stage filter: show all open) | completed/done | Correctly unchanged (No verdict) |
| WL-0MSGSE15000746F7 (shortcut to return to default) | completed/done | Correctly unchanged (No verdict) |

### Root Cause (for reference)

The audit runner historically had a bug where "Ready to close: Yes" verdicts produced via fallback/tainted paths (e.g. read-only audits where tests could not run) would restore pre-audit state instead of advancing to completed/in_review. This was fixed in the audit runner code (audit_runner.py `_apply_terminal_lifecycle`).

## Acceptance Criteria Status

- [x] AC1: Both Yes items transitioned to terminal states (completed/done or deleted)
- [x] AC2: No items with "No" verdicts were changed
- [x] AC3: Mid-workflow items left untouched
- [x] AC4: Resolution documented in work-item description and comments

## Current Audit Runner Behavior

When ``audit_verdict == "yes"``: advances to completed, keeps done stage if already done, otherwise sets in_review
When ``audit_verdict == "no"`` (genuine): returns to open/plan_complete
On failure: restores pre-audit state

## No remaining stuck items

Verified: 0 items with "Ready to close: Yes" audits remain outside terminal states (completed/done, completed/in_review, or deleted).
data.title: Fix stuck stage/status on audit-completed work items
